stepExplanation:
Using Faraday's Law: $$\varepsilon = -N\frac{\Delta\Phi}{\Delta t}$$
$$|\varepsilon| = N\frac{|\Delta\Phi|}{\Delta t} = 200 \times \frac{0.03}{0.1} = 200 \times 0.3 = 60 \text{ V}$$
stepBody: Using Faraday's Law (ε = -NΔΦ/Δt), calculate the magnitude of the induced EMF. N = 200 turns, |ΔΦ| = 0.03 Wb, Δt = 0.1 s. Give your answer in Volts.
